name: Notify User
description: Send a message to a person on their messaging channel (e.g. Telegram). Use it to tell someone something proactively - when you run autonomously your normal reply text is NOT delivered anywhere. To reach a person, pass 'to' with their name and optionally 'channel': the name is looked up in the address book. NEVER invent a numeric id.

to.description: Who to send it to: a person's name from the address book — pick one of the listed values when this parameter has them, otherwise write the name and the error will list who exists. "all" sends to every contact on that channel: use it only when you were asked to tell everyone. Omit to use the agent's configured target.

channel.description: Which messaging channel to use. Only needed when more than one is configured.

binding_id.description: Advanced: the exact bot to send through. Prefer 'channel'. LEAVE THIS ARGUMENT OUT to use the agent's configured target — do not pass the word "default" or any placeholder.

chat_id.description: Advanced: the exact chat id, when you already know it. Prefer 'to', which wins over this one and over the agent's configured target. Several recipients: comma-separated. LEAVE THIS ARGUMENT OUT to use the agent's configured target — do not pass the word "default" or any placeholder.
